themes: US solar and storage names are re-rating on hyperscaler power purchase agreements and grid interconnection queues, a durable demand signal independent of interest-rate swings.

sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed solar and grid names (FSLR, ENPH, SEDG) on the AI-driven power-demand repricing; Indonesia exposure stays muted—watch for tariff clarity and local content rules before adding. sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's FMCG sector is structurally supported by a rising middle class and urbanization, which sustains volume growth for local brands even as global peers decelerate.
Regulatory tailwinds on domestic content requirements and food security push manufacturers to localize supply chains, boosting margins for agile mid-caps over import-dependent multinationals.
Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are compressing go-to-market costs, enabling smaller listed players to scale faster and re-rate, as seen in today's 10-20% single-day moves.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian consumer names on momentum, but rotate out of crowded staples into mid-cap turnaround stories (PPRI, MSJA, JAWA) where local demand and margin repair are driving outsized gains; the US drag is noise—IDX consumer leadership confirms domestic resilience, so add on any pullback toward 5%+ upside names with clean balance sheets.

sectors.name: Healthcare
themes: Indonesia's mandatory health insurance expansion and rising middle-class out-of-pocket spend structurally lift local pharma and hospital volumes, insulating domestic names from global rate cycles.

Rotate toward SOHO's momentum and SDPC's distribution reach, avoiding US-exposed insurers until Fed clarity emerges.
